senses.gloss: उत्-तेजक, अस्, आ, अम्, instigating, stimulating.

उत्-तेजन, अम्, आ, n. f. incitement, instigation, excit-
ing, animating; sending, despatching; urging, driving;
whetting, sharpening, furbishing, polishing; an in-
spiring or exciting speech; an incentive, inducement,
stimulant.

उत्-तेजित, अस्, आ, अम्, incited, animated, excited,
urged; sent, despatched; whetted, sharpened, fur-
bished, polished; (अम्), n. an incentive, inducement;
sidling, one of a horse's five paces; moderate velocity
in a horse's pace.

उत्तेरित उत्तेरित, अम्, n. (said to be fr. उत्-
तॄ, but perhaps connected with rt. ईर्), one of the
five paces of a horse in Hindū jockeyship.
